title: Quasi-coherent modules on a groupoid scheme with flat s and t are directed colimits of their kappa-generated submodules

statement_spans.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-colimit-kappa (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 3369-3377

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: choose a cardinal kappa dominating the index sets of an affine cover of U and of affine covers of the pairwise intersections and of the s-t fibres; for a family of small subsets S_i of M_i close it up under the finite-expression operators S(i,j,k,m) drawn from the alpha-descent isomorphisms on the W_ijk and the intersection opens; after omega many steps the generated submodules N_i satisfy the matching conditions N_i x A_ijk = N_j x A_ijk and alpha(N_i x B_ijk) = N_j x B_ijk, so they glue to a kappa-generated quasi-coherent submodule with the cocycle condition; the poset of such submodules is directed since sums are kappa-generated, and every section lands in one, so F is the directed colimit (source lines 3379-3483)

core_obligations: Set-up (proof lines 3382-3401): submodule means quasi-coherent G with alpha(t*G) = s*G, well defined since s, t flat are exact; kappa dominates the cardinalities of I, I_ij, J_ij.

Closure construction (proof lines 3404-3460): choose by axiom of choice finite expression sets S(i,j,k,m) in M_j realizing m x 1 or alpha(m x 1) on each affine piece (01I9); closing any family of subsets of size <= kappa under S' and iterating omega times gives S^(inf) of size <= kappa; the generated N_i satisfy both matching identities, hence glue to a kappa-generated quasi-coherent submodule (G, alpha|) of (F, alpha).

Directedness and colimit (proof lines 3462-3483): sums of kappa-generated submodules are kappa-generated images of a direct sum, so the poset is directed; every section over U_i can be seeded into S_i, so it lands in some G_t; the colimit map is injective and surjective.
proof_roadmap: Fix kappa and the affine data, define submodule and the alpha-isomorphisms on the pieces (proof lines 3382-3423).
Close up small families under the finite-expression operators and glue the resulting submodules (proof lines 3404-3460).
Show the poset of kappa-generated submodules is directed and exhausts F (proof lines 3462-3483).
